feeding_claim.verbatim: Our animals are grown here locally, on home grown hay, haylege, corn silage, small amounts of soybean meal, and minerals.

resold_note: Also sells lamb sourced from other Maine farms and chicken described only as locally raised.
notes: Scout 2026-11-26: read the homepage, About, Products, All-Natural Beef, Black Label Reserve, Locally Sourced Lamb and Packages and Sales pages; the Natural Farm Raised Pork page returned only a bot-check screen twice. Large operation (site says about 700 beef cows) with a retail store and custom processing plant; open Mon to Fri 8 to 5, Sat 8 to 2, Sun 9 to 12, curbside pickup or in-store shopping. Beef fed hay, haylage, corn silage and some soybean meal, in pastures in summer; the site never uses the words grass-fed or grain, so category is percentage (Verifier may prefer grain-finished; corn silage contains grain). Products page says 'pastured pork'; Verifier should read the pork page to confirm the farm raises its pigs. Quote came from a WebFetch summary. Sides $4.19/lb, hind quarters $4.39/lb, fore quarters $3.99/lb hanging weight. No delivery or shipping mentioned.
